worldcombat.skill.dragoncheer.summary: A draconic cry covers the user and nearby allies: for a while they have a better chance to crit, and Dragon-type allies are roused the most. An ally already under Focus Energy is not roused.
worldcombat.skill.dragoncheer.use.0: Open a fight with a roar that lifts the whole team's crit chance
worldcombat.skill.dragoncheer.use.1: Give Dragon-type allies the stronger cheer
worldcombat.skill.dragoncheer.use.2: Lay the morale down before the team's combo
worldcombat.skill.dragoncheer.descriptio: Non-Dragon allies gain about %1$s crit chance on each damaging hit, Dragon-type allies about %2$s - the Dragon tier is always higher.
worldcombat.skill.dragoncheer.roar.on: Long roar: wider radius, longer duration and a higher bonus, at the cost of %1$s telegraph and %2$s cooldown - cover the whole team once before the fight.
worldcombat.skill.dragoncheer.roar.off: Short bark: a little narrower, shorter and weaker, but lower telegraph and cooldown - top up morale whenever in a long trade.
worldcombat.skill.dragoncheer.descriptio: The morale stays on allies for %1$s and the wave covers every ally within %2$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.dragoncheer.timing: Self move, range %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of telegraph it costs %4$s PP to fire, then %3$s s recovery and %5$s s cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.dragoncheer.preference: On: long roar, radius x1.15, duration x1.25 and a higher bonus, but 4 ticks more telegraph and a longer cooldown - cover the whole team once before the fight. Off: short bark, radius x0.9, duration x0.8 and x0.9 bonus, with a lower telegraph and cooldown, ready to top up in a long trade.
Consider the roar when a threat is within this distance; larger starts gathering the cry earlier.
Worth casting when an uncheered ally is within this distance; smaller roars only up close, larger reaches for a further ally.
On: a hold order no longer stops it from leaving its post to cheer allies.
